statement: On the frozen R5 confirmation seeds 8101-8105, the linear noise contrast, the leaf-cap residual and clean-risk contrasts, and the restricted-forest size contrast replicated in the predeclared directions. Those replications do not identify one shared mechanism.
limitations: The replications do not identify one shared mechanism.
The MLP budget result and the boosting-depth curve were not re-fit.
Standard errors are not confidence intervals.
scientific_validity remains not_assessed. This is local Cursor team review by a distinct subagent, not an external replication.
